notes: Cross-verse consistency with NUM.24.6. The supplied 'Who' of 'Who seeth the vision of the Almighty' was folded into the finite verb under rule 46's headless-relative clause, but that clause governs only a relative clause with no antecedent of its own. Here the participle שֹׁמֵעַ stands written before it as the antecedent — the same antecedent the אֲשֶׁר of NUM.24.4 attaches this very clause to — so rule 46's closing limit applies and rule 55 decides the word: a subordinator the ASV supplies for a clause whose Hebrew writes none is added. That is how NUM.24.6 already reads its supplied 'which' before 'Jehovah hath planted'. The verb keeps only its own 'seeth'; every other unit is unchanged.
